text:
sam_fin: FYI partner CloudBridge flagged an April overpayment - they claim we charged them twice for a burst of 10 spot-hours on Apr 9. can billing confirm?

ada_billing: pulling marketplace report + our import. please hold.

clare_partners: partner pasted CSV snippet: 
```
sku,usage_start,usage_end,units,tag
redwood-inference.spot,2026-04-09T02:00:00Z,2026-04-09T03:00:00Z,10,burst-2026-04-09
```
They say ledger shows two identical lines for that tag.

ops-bot: deploy: billing-ingest v3.1.4 rolled out on 2026-04-09T01:45:02Z.

ada_billing: raw marketplace file has single line. our ledger import shows two lines — looks like duplication happened during de-dup step. import logs: "info: duplicate-key not found -> generating new id" then later "warn: upsert created duplicate for same tag due to missing uniqueness constraint".

sam_fin: how much money is at stake?

ada_billing: unit price for spot hour = $250. 10 * 250 = $2,500. Duplicate => partner was overcharged $2,500.

clare_partners: partner already escalated to their finance team; they're holding payout until resolved.

toni_treasury: pre-approve refund/credit of $2,500 if ledger backfill confirms and we post correcting journal.

ada_billing: proposed fix: (1) issue credit note for $2,500 labeled "duplicate ingestion duplication"; (2) remove duplicate row from ledger and re-import; (3) add uniqueness constraint on (partner_id, sku, usage_start, tag) in ingest; (4) add test to catch duplicate upserts.

sam_fin: sounds good. please create FIN ticket and attach credit note draft.

ada_billing: FIN-3555 created: "CloudBridge duplicate spot usage Apr 9". Draft credit attached. backfill file: s3://redwood-billing/backfills/2026-04-09-cloudbridge-dedupe.csv import id imp-2026-04-10-8891.

toni_treasury: scheduling payment/credit in next AP run. mark FIN-3555 approved for payment.

clare_partners: partner confirmed they see the credit pending and will release their payable. thanks.

ada_billing: RCA summary: billing-ingest v3.1.4 deploy removed a defensive uniqueness check during refactor, allowing duplicate upserts when import retried. Impact: one duplicated line = $2,500 overcharge. Remediation: issued $2,500 credit, backfilled ledger, reintroduced uniqueness constraint, added retry idempotency check, and added monitoring for duplicate-upsert rate.

sam_fin: good closure. please ensure controller approves GL entries before month-end close.

toni_treasury: noted. leaving thread open until payment posts.
